Chapter 325: Chapter 19 Numerous Arrogant Talents in the World, Who Dares to Stand Side by Side with You (Please Subscribe)_2

Although the Heiyuan Clan’s focus is mainly on Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers,

they generally don’t actively pursue the killing of Fourth Rank and Fifth Rank Evolvers.

However, if Fourth Rank or Fifth Rank Evolvers intrude into the attack range of a powerful member of the Heiyuan Clan, it comes as no surprise if they are taken down.

“Among the thirty-six Seventh Rank Evolvers, fifteen possess the Doppelganger Skill; among the five hundred and seventy-two Sixth Rank Evolvers, one hundred and twenty-seven possess the skill…”

Xueyou continued to speak.

A small portion of Seventh Rank Evolvers, and the majority of Eighth Layer Evolvers,

...

in addition to contemplating Space Rules, are also involved with the rules of causality.

The rules of causality, while not as foundational as the Space Rules, are enigmatic and unpredictable.

Those who have a deeper understanding of the rules of causality can develop many bizarre techniques, such as the Curse-Killing Skill?

The Curse-Killing Skill is just one of the many applications of the causality rules; the uses of this rule are plentiful.

For example, when Xueyou kills an Evolver, the moment the killing intent surges, a connection of cause and effect is established between the two.

If Xueyou successfully kills the target, the causality will cease to exist with the death of the person,

which means he would no longer feel any causal connection to that Evolver, thus confirming the target’s demise.

If, after the killing, a faint sense of causality is still perceived,

it could mean that the target has not died and likely has techniques like the Doppelganger Skill at their disposal.

“Indeed.”

The unicorn man nodded slightly upon hearing this.

Although the result is quite different from the expectation of completely purging all human Evolvers,

achieving such results is still quite remarkable—

at least twenty-one Seventh Rank human Evolvers have died.

The remaining Seventh Rank Evolvers, even if their true bodies are alive, have suffered a severe cost with the death of a doppelganger.

…

On Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

“Not only did Battlefield C24763 experience a purge by different species at the same time, but there were also five thousand four hundred and sixty-three other alien battlefields undergoing the same purge?”

Lin Yuan furrowed his brows slightly as he received the news.

“All these battlefields of different races under the Insect Race Alliance… Is the Insect Race really intending to start a full-scale war with the Human Race?”

Lin Yuan was puzzled.

Generally speaking, it was rare for Peak Clans to engage in serious conflict.

Whether it be the Human Race, the Insect Race, or other major peak clans,

they all had proven their might in the long wars of the past.

It was implausible for one side to completely annihilate the other.

Thus, the intensity of the wars was tacitly maintained within a certain range.

“There must be a reason for this…”

Lin Yuan connected his consciousness to the Virtual World.

Personal space.

Shi Feng stepped out from the void, his red nose unmistakable.

“Shisan, little brother.”

“If you want to know why the Insect Race is going crazy, I happen to know some inside information…”

Shi Feng said with a grin,

as a Sixth Rank citizen and a founder of an Evolution Path,

Shi Feng had a vast network of connections.

“What’s the reason?”

Lin Yuan asked.

Even if Shi Feng didn’t know, Lin Yuan had planned to ask several senior fellow disciples,

or even inquire directly from Chikun Starlord, his teacher.

It was only natural for Lin Yuan to be curious and ask a few more questions about such significant developments on the alien battlefields.

“It’s because of the Large Alien Battlefield…”

Shi Feng didn’t keep him in suspense, speaking in a hushed tone.

“Large Alien Battlefield?”

Lin Yuan felt a slight shock in his heart.

There are over two million battlefields opened up between humans and different species,

with just over one hundred of them being large battlefields.

Large Alien Battlefields are where the Human Civilization clashes with other Peak Clans.

Even Supreme Beings occasionally turn their gaze toward the Large Alien Battlefields and may sometimes intervene.

“The reason the Insect Race is targeting small and medium-sized battlefields is because of an event that is about to take place above Battlefield S111,”

Shi Feng explained mysteriously.

“The top oracle of the Insect Race has predicted that, soon, a foreign visitor will come to Battlefield S111, through the Eternal Spatial Rift.”

“To be precise, it’s the corpse of a visitor from beyond.”

“This corpse must be very important, so important that the Insect Race wants to have it all to themselves, ordering many clans within the Alliance to put forth their full strength to cause trouble for our Human Civilization…”

“This is in order to gain an advantageous position in the upcoming struggle for this corpse.”

Shi Feng told him.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

Eternal Spatial Rifts on the Large Alien Battlefields are enormous, spanning tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of miles,

and occasionally foreign visitors cross through such vast spatial rifts to enter the Main World.

“`

“What was the outcome?”

Lin Yuan asked.

Whose hands did the corpse of the extraterrestrial visitor that floated in from the spatial rift fall into?

“What else could have happened?”

“The Insect Race was able to deduce this matter; how could our human civilization be completely unaware?”

Red-nosed Shi Feng shook his head and said, “Besides, the supreme beings from the several other peak clans also approached, wanting a share of the spoils.”

“In the end, the outsider’s corpse was torn to pieces, and our human civilization should have gotten a part of it.”

After finishing his statement, red-nosed Shi Feng added with some surprise, “I wonder what is so miraculous about that corpse that even the supreme beings vied for it?”

“That’s a question for the supreme beings…”

Lin Yuan shook his head.

…

After chatting with red-nosed Shi Feng for a few more lines.

Lin Yuan then disconnected the virtual world connection and his consciousness returned to reality.

“The teacher is looking for me?”

“Is it about the matters on the alien battlefield?”

Lin Yuan suddenly received a message from the Chikun Star Lord, asking him and his fellow disciples to come to him.

The sudden foul play of the various species from the Insect Race Alliance on the battlefield would definitely not be left as is,

Next, it would be the human civilization’s turn to retaliate.

…

Outside the crimson hall.

Zuo Ge, the Fourth Disciple, and the other Peak Masters stood chatting idly.

They too had heard about the events that transpired on the alien battlefield, and their conversation mainly revolved around it.

As the disciples chatted.

They eventually talked about Lin Yuan.

“Ah, we consider ourselves evolutionary geniuses, belonging to the first class of outstanding talents, but when compared with our little junior brother…”

The Sixth Disciple sighed. Even now, he was still shocked by Lin Yuan’s step to the Seventh Rank.

The Seventh Rank.

This was the Seventh Rank.

It’s not cabbage on the side of the road.

Something you step into just because you wish to?

“Indeed, how exactly does our junior brother cultivate? Could it be that he always practices so diligently that he doesn’t even dream?”

The other disciples exchanged glances, all filled with deep emotion.

The entire outer world was abuzz when the Thirteenth Peak Master stepped into the Seventh Rank,

And inside the Red Kun Lineage, the shock was not much less, all filled with astonishment.

It should be known,

That the Peak Masters were taken as disciples by the Chikun Star Lord because of their undeniable talents,

Worthy of the title of evolutionary prodigies.

Even though the First, Second, and Third Disciples had stepped into the Seventh Rank,

Zuo Ge and the other Peak Masters had no doubt or questioning about themselves,

Believing that they would eventually break through to the same level one day.

Until they met the little junior brother, Lin Yuan…

“Junior brother is coming.”

Zuo Ge and the other Peak Masters seemed to sense something, smiles appeared on their faces as they looked towards the figure walking over from a distance, it was Lin Yuan.

“Fourth Disciple, Fifth Disciple, Sixth Disciple…”

Lin Yuan greeted each one in turn.

“Junior brother, the teacher is waiting for us inside, let’s hurry in.”

Zuo Ge, the Fourth Disciple, spoke up.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded and walked into the crimson hall.

Zuo Ge, the Fourth Disciple, and the other disciples also followed him in.

For some reason, Zuo Ge and the others intentionally fell half a step behind Lin Yuan, not walking shoulder to shoulder.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan seemed to notice something and stopped to look back at his fellow disciples.

“Disciples, there really is no need for this…”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help saying, he didn’t feel that stepping into the Seventh Rank made him thoroughly superior, some things, and some people, still needed to be analyzed specifically.

When Lin Yuan had just joined the Red Kun Lineage and became the Thirteenth Peak Master, the fellow disciples had taken great care of him.

“You’re thinking too much, junior brother, we just feel a bit of pressure walking alongside you…”

Zuo Ge, the Fourth Disciple, spoke the truth.

“Well, okay then.”

Lin Yuan thought about it and didn’t say much, continuing towards the depths of the palace.

Zuo Ge, the Fourth Disciple, and the other Peak Master Disciples exchanged glances.

With the talents Lin Yuan was currently displaying, in several decades or a few hundred years, he likely has the potential to challenge the Eighth Layer.

To become a great figure at the same level as the Star Lord.

Such potential,

Such talent,

Such ability.

With countless prodigies in the world, who dares walk shoulder to shoulder with you?
